status: Local exploratory PSNR and SSIM; supplementary review plot, not installed in manuscript

settings.intensity: Original signed, sky-subtracted linear MJy/sr in central 105x105 pixels; no rescaling, clipping, offset, flux fitting or noise subtraction.
settings.data_range: For each cutout, max(target[common_valid])-min(target[common_valid]); identical for every method and all three regions. No model-dependent ranges.
settings.psnr: 20 log10(data_range / per-object regional RMSE); arithmetic mean of per-object dB, not PSNR of mean RMSE. All regional common-valid pixels included.
settings.ssim: scikit-image local SSIM: uniform 7x7 window, sample covariance, K1=0.01, K2=0.03. Average only centres whose entire window lies inside the selected region and common-valid support, including at image borders. Then average objects equally. Source/outside pixels are not zeroed. Invalid pixels are filled only for computation and cannot enter retained windows.
settings.bootstrap: 2000 paired spatial-block bootstrap resamples, seed 20261017, over 18 blocks; equal object weighting; 95% percentile intervals. Paired score differences relative to bilinear saved.
